title: Electrical Engineering, B.S. (College of Engineering)
notes: University Park. Verified 2026-08-27 against the real EECS department handbook (the current 'Blue Program' 2025-2026 EE Program Booklet, https://www.eecs.psu.edu/assets/docs/handbooks/EE-Program-Booklet.pdf), not just the bulletin. Every 300-level, 400-level, and combined 300/400-level 'EE or CMPEN elective' slot is wired to the handbook's real enumerated lists (pp.10-12) via 'match' regexes. 'Statistics elective' is wired to the handbook's exact list (STAT 418/414/401, EE 465, IE 424 -- IE added to departments; STAT 418/EE 465 are the handbook's own 'strongly recommended' picks but all five count). 'Related elective' (handbook: a real but sprawling denylist spanning departments this plan doesn't even load, e.g. ME/NUCE/ESC/ENGR/IE-452/PLET) is wired via open_elective with the subset of that denylist that falls within this plan's own departments (EE 211/212/353/465; CMPSC 100/101/200/201/203; ENGL 4/5) plus a broad MATH/PHYS/ESL/CAS/ECON exclusion approximating the handbook's much more granular 'PHYS below 200, and 250-400 except 401/402/444/457/458' / 'MATH below 111, and 200/318-319/470/471/475' carve-outs -- documented approximation, not a fabricated exact match, since a single elective_min_level can't express two different per-department floors on one slot. Fixed 3 real discrepancies against the bulletin/handbook: (1) CRITICAL -- the plan's own inserted MATH 3/MATH 4 chain was flatly wrong: math_catalog.json's MATH 21 entry has an empty prereq_groups (doesn't need MATH 4 at all), and the handbook explicitly bars MATH 001-111 from counting toward ANY EE graduation requirement while MATH 3/4's own catalog descriptions say the same about baccalaureate minimums -- this also inflated every semester's item-sum above its own stated target_credits (e.g. Semester 1: 18cr of items vs a 15cr target). Removed MATH 3 (Semester 1) and MATH 4 (Semester 2) entirely; MATH 21/MATH 22 (Semesters 3-4) remain as an engine-only fallback for a hypothetical student with no reported math placement (see expand_math_placement in planner_engine.py) -- for a realistic incoming EE student who places into MATH 140, this waives instantly per math_placement_satisfied. (2) The GHW (Health & Wellness) Gen Ed was in the wrong semester at the wrong credit value -- Semester 5's plain 'GEN ED' item was actually a mislabeled 1cr GHW slot, and Semester 6 carried a real 'GEN ED (GHW)' that the handbook shows as a plain, non-GHW Gen Ed -- swapped: GHW (1.5cr) now in Semester 5, plain Gen Ed (3cr) in Semester 6. (3) Semester 7 was missing its required Gen Ed slot entirely while carrying an extra 400-level tech elective, and Semester 8 was short one 400-level elective versus the handbook's real '5 electives, 15cr total' rule -- moved one 'EE or CMPEN 400-Level elective' from Semester 7 to Semester 8 and added the missing Gen Ed to Semester 7 (both semesters' target_credits were already internally correct and needed no further change; total plan Gen Ed credits now sum to the real 18cr instead of ~13cr, a downstream consequence of fixes 2-3). No EE-specific Gen Ed domain exclusions found beyond the standard PSU structure. Checked ee_catalog.json for mutually-exclusive course pairs: none populated/needed beyond what's already fixed elsewhere (CHEM 110/106/130 already in chem_catalog.json; CMPSC 451/455 already fixed per the CMPSC reference commit).
